div.head: VI Atr 26.1
div.ab: ⁊ sitte ælc XII monað werleas; ceose syþþan þæt heo sylf wille.
And sitte ælc XII monað wereleas; ⁊ ceose siððan þæt heo silf wille.
⁊ sitte ælc XII monað werleas; ceose syþþan þæt heo sylf wille.
And sitte ælc XII monað werleas; ceose syþþan þæt heo sylf wille.
Und sitze jede ein Jahr lang gattenlos; wähle sie hernach, was sie selbst will.
And let each remain without a husband for twelve months; afterwards let her choose what she herself wishes.
And each of them shall remain without a husband for a year, after which she may decide as she herself desires.
And each of them is to remain husbandless for twelve months; then she may choose as she pleases.
